name: Gut Punch
location: The SE corner of the garage.
description: Start by laybacking the brick jamb. Make your way up the corner and arête, then topout on the second level.

name: Mantle Corner
location: The south side, to the right of the stairwell.
description: Start by laybacking or jamming the corner. Topout.

name: Tight Hands
location: The south side, in the middle.
description: Climb the discontinuous crack. Topout the first level.

name: Tight Hands Highball
location: The south side, in the middle.
description: Climb the discontinuous crack all the way to the top, then topout.

name: Brick Fist (open project)
location: On the east side.
description: Climb the fist/teacup crack. This one is super mega! Let me know if you want to try it.

name: Sodomizer Dyno (open project)
location: On top of the gaarage, on one of the stairwells
description: Get stood up on the window frame and dyno. Topout onto the stairwell.

name: Lafayette arete
location: East side of the building.
description: Start by the sign, but don't use it. Figure your way through the reachy moves until you can topout onto the beam. Downclimb/jump.

name: Lafayette Pillar
location: East side of the building.
description: Climb the pillar until you can topout onto the beam. Downclimb/jump.

name: Backstage Corner
location: Behind the theatre, near the lafayette climbs. The brick corner with the 1-inch crack.
description: Layback the corner, topout onto the wall, then downclimb.

name: NE Chimney
location: By the north entrance, the chimney in the corner to the left of the doors.
description: Can be climbed like a squeeze chimney, or can be laybacked.

name: NW Chimney
location: By the north entrance, the chimney in the corner to the right of the doors.
description: Can be climbed like a chimney, or can be laybacked.

name: Pillar Face
location: On the east side of the building, the pillar next to the walkway.
description: Climb the face without using the arete. Finish by tapping the pipe, then downclimb or jump.

name: Pillar Arete
location: On the east side of the building, the pillar next to the walkway.
description: Climb the arete. Finish by tapping the pipe, then downclimb or jump.

name: Traverse
location: The west side of the building. On the lawn.
description: Start at the pipe and traverse the all all the way to the other pipe. Pumpy. You can also start earlier and finish later. Students have been climbing this wall for decades.

name: Tower?
description: Could probably highball the tower, finish sitting in the window frame.

name: Dumb High
location: To the left of "The Niche".
description: There is no topout, it's in the name.

name: The Niche
location: To the left of the stairs.
description: Use the crimps to topout.

name: Crimp Line
location: To the right of "The Niche".
description: Squat start to the left of the granite streak. Traverse right then topout onto the stairs.

name: The Chimney
location: To the right of the stairs
description: Climb the chimney then topout.

name: The Dogleg (open project)
location: To the left of Mantelpiece.
description: Start with a run and jump to the horizontal jug, then mantel in the corner. Move right to the frame, then move right again and use the same topout as Mantelpiece.

name: Mantlepiece
location: To the right the entrance by the parking lot. The left of the two corners.
description: Start on crimps, then climb the corner and topout.

name: Short Cut
location: To the right the entrance by the parking lot. The right of the two corners.
description: Start on the crimps, figure out the sequence to topout. Reachy.

name: L&L Crack
location: Along the busy walkway, across from L&L climb the left-most (longest) crack on the mural.
description: Shallow ringlocks, One-mover pull-on crux. Kind of cool!

name: Crack Bum
location: The left of the two cracks.
description: Start on the crack. Climb the crack using the sloper. Topout.

name: With No Light
location: The right of the two cracks
description: Start by campusing the ring-locks. Climb the crack using the sloper. Topout.

name: Box Eater
location: The off-width under the two cracks.
description: I'm pretty sure this one goes, I've done a move on it... and every move is the same. It's bigger than two fists is the challenge. You kind of need a spotter to help you get out.

name: Rusty Trombone
location: Near the stairwell on the 4th floor.
description: Start standing on the railing. Climb the roof crack then finsih by swinging your feet onto the other railing. This climbs exists on every floor in different sizes. May be rusty or have debris,but don't let that deter you, just a wire brush would be nice.

name: Easy Access
location: North of the other climbs.
description: Start with run and jump or tricky layback, then use the sloper and thin corner. Topout

name: The Outside
description: There are many possible routes on the outside of the garage. None have been climbed.

name: Creek Freak
location: North west corner of the garage north of target.
description: This climb is obviously duplicated many times, but the most discrete version is described. Start by reaching high, then climb all three stories, you could bail at any story. The crack is a really good handjam, and sometimes it is wide enough to reach all the way back to a jug.

name: Henry Can't Do It
location: The tower.
description: The tower at Ethan Allen park can be climbed with gear as a sketchy 5.10, or top-roped. It is described in the forward of Vermont Rock.
